hero.statement: Shopify developer in Paris, building stores for brands that care about the details.

michino.description: I build new features and improve the store every day as the brand’s in-house developer.

projects.faureLePage: Custom sections and features for a prestigious French luxury house.
projects.plaq: Gift suggestions in the sidecart and a test page that guides customers to the right product.
projects.novoma: A complex in-house theme. I took ownership of key pages, including the homepage, and worked on the architecture.
projects.terreDeBougies: Built from scratch in a team of three, including the product page and a custom calculator.
projects.franklin: A large store I helped evolve over several years, including a redesign of the sidecart.
projects.inlissa: Custom sections such as an advanced Ingredients block, with a strong focus on web performance.
projects.cairn: A store I built on my own, adapted to new brand guidelines and functional requirements.

about.text: I started as an intern in 2020 and have worked on Shopify ever since, first in agencies and now in-house at a luxury brand. I speak Persian, English and French fluently.
about.alliance: Alliance Française, French A1 to B2
